# Troubleshooting
Actions > failed run > build > the step with the red cross.
- "The file X is missing": upload X and run again.
- Warnings "Build failed. Trying again without...": the build still produced an app, just without the optional parts.
- Web pages show "offline" or do not load: check Private DNS (Android Settings > Network > Private DNS) and any ad-blocking DNS.
- A page closes with "ran out of memory": close other web apps; heavy sites like YouTube desktop use a lot of memory.
- App not installed: uninstall the old one first (this deletes its data), or use the same debug.keystore.
- Forgot the lock password: uninstall and reinstall. Forgot the Vault master password: it cannot be recovered.
